content:
This is a Forge port of the Fabric/NeoForge mod You're in Grave Danger.

You're in Grave Danger.

Get it?

About

You're in Grave Danger is a mod centered around death.

When you die, a grave spawns at your death location and stores your items safely. Come back, reclaim your loot, and keep moving without the usual “explode into a mess” frustration.

Graves are highly configurable. If you ever think “it should be possible to change that,” there’s a good chance it already is.

Note: This mod is required on both client and server, since it adds custom blocks and rendering.

Key Features

Graves (Configurable)

  • Graves generate on death and store your items until you reclaim them.
  • Control where/when graves can generate and what goes into them.
  • Graves can be waterlogged.
  • Optional adaptive rendering so the grave better matches the block it’s placed on.

Inventory Layout Restore

  • The mod remembers your inventory layout and puts everything back where it was before you died.

Soulbound Support (Optional)

  • Includes a built-in Soulbound enchant by default (can be enabled/disabled via config).

Multiplayer Friendly

  • Easily identify your grave: optional rendering of your player name and face/skin on the grave.

Resource Pack Customization

  • Customize graves using resource packs:
    • block hitbox
    • model/render parts
    • skull visuals
    • text rendering

Commands / Admin Tools

  • /yigd restore — restore graves
  • /yigd grave — view info about a grave
  • /yigd rob <player> — remotely grab someone else’s grave (use responsibly; configurable)
  • /yigd moderate — display all player graves
  • Optional whitelist-style config to restrict who can generate graves

Compatibility

  • Numismatic Overhaul
  • Curious API

Requirements

  • Cloth Config API
